retention_rule: Preserve the original public manuscript and study subtrees byte-for-byte, retain licenses and reader guidance, and keep earlier research reachable through retained Git history. Place the central saved-loss analysis and supplementary capacity implementation in separately documented experiment bundles.
scope: Original public manuscript and study files are unchanged. Experiment-only bundles add saved-loss reconstruction and the recovered supplementary capacity study. No model fitting, new numerical results, revised manuscript upload, or history rewrite is included.

reproduction/score_enrichment.scope: Independent statistical reconstruction from preserved central-study loss records

reproduction/capacity_followup.scope: Supplementary capacity implementation and original compact records
